title: Operations & CRM Systems Virtual Assistant (Full-Time Executive Support for COO)
description:
About CoolHed



CoolHed is a fast-growing wellness and thermoregulation company delivering evidence-based solutions across workplace safety, mental health, athletic recovery, education, and corporate wellness. We work with organizations, health professionals, schools, athletes, and industry partners to improve wellbeing, performance, and safety through innovative cooling and recovery technologies.



As we scale across Australia and international markets, we are seeking a highly organized, systems-driven Operations & CRM Systems Specialist to support our COO and build the operational infrastructure that powers our growth.



The Role



This is not a traditional virtual assistant role.



You will own and optimize the systems that drive lead management, partnership development, product rollouts, event follow-up, and executive operations. Your primary objective is to transform contacts, conference leads, and strategic opportunities into structured pipelines that generate measurable business outcomes.



You will work directly with the COO to build scalable operating systems across our key growth pillars:



Construction & Workplace Safety

Mental Health & Corporate Wellness

Education & Kids Programs

Athletic Recovery & Performance

International Expansion (including Japan)

Key Responsibilities

CRM & Pipeline Management (40%)

Own and maintain the company's CRM platform (HubSpot, Pipedrive, Airtable, or equivalent).

Build, organize, and manage contact databases across multiple industry sectors.

Segment leads and create structured sales and partnership pipelines.

Design and execute automated and personalized follow-up workflows.

Track lead progression, engagement, opportunities, and conversion metrics.

Ensure all contacts, conversations, and next actions are accurately recorded.

Operations & Rollout Systems (30%)

Design and improve operating systems for product trials, pilots, and large-scale rollouts.

Coordinate logistics for events, shipments, inventory, and partner activations.

Build dashboards that provide visibility into pipeline health, conversion rates, ROI, and forecasting.

Support implementation projects across workplace safety, education, wellness, and international initiatives.

Events & Outreach (15%)

Manage pre-event preparation and post-event follow-up processes.

Execute structured lead nurturing following conferences and industry events.

Coordinate meetings, scheduling, and follow-up communications.

Maintain detailed records of stakeholder interactions and partnership opportunities.

COO & Executive Operations Support (15%)

Manage calendars, travel coordination, and executive scheduling.

Organize contracts, regulatory documents, patents, and business records.

Track expenses and support reporting requirements.

Conduct market, supplier, and partnership research.

Create SOPs and documentation for repeatable business processes.

Required Skills & Experience

Essential

Proven experience building and managing CRM systems and operational workflows.

Strong hands-on experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Airtable, Notion, or similar platforms.

Advanced Google Workspace and/or Microsoft 365 proficiency.

Experience managing professional relationships and nurturing B2B leads.

Strong project management and organizational skills.

Excellent written and verbal communication.

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

High attention to detail and commitment to confidentiality.

Highly Desirable

Experience in health, wellness, medical devices, workplace safety, education, or startup environments.

Familiarity with Australian business practices.

Experience with event logistics and international shipping.

Knowledge of automation platforms such as Zapier or Make.

What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days

All existing and new leads entered, segmented, and actively managed within the CRM.

Automated follow-up systems implemented and operating effectively.

Real-time dashboards providing visibility across all growth pillars.

SOPs documented for key business processes.

COO workload reduced by 15–20+ hours per week through improved systems and delegation.

Tangible pipeline growth resulting in pilots, partnerships, and revenue opportunities.

Ideal Candidate



You are a systems thinker who enjoys creating order from complexity.



You thrive in growth-stage environments, take ownership of outcomes, and proactively identify opportunities to improve processes. You enjoy building scalable systems, managing relationships, and helping leaders operate more effectively.



If you are excited by the opportunity to play a central role in scaling a purpose-driven company, we'd love to hear from you.



How to Apply



Please submit:



Your resume/CV.

A brief summary of your CRM and operations experience.

Examples of systems, automations, or workflows you have built.

A short Loom video (optional but highly encouraged) introducing yourself and explaining why you're a strong fit for this role.



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: AI-Native Video Editor | DTC Paid Social Ads
description:
Got the Evolve format. Real talk before I write it: your draft has one contradiction that'll bite you. You say "you don't need to be the finished article" then say "experience is essential." That softness invites underqualified applicants. At 50 concepts/month + $2-3K, you can't afford to train someone from zero. So I'm tightening that.



Also baking in your real filter (Loom video + actual proof, no NDA excuses) because that's what separates editors who've actually shipped ads from portfolio cosplayers.



Here it is:



---



**VIDEO EDITOR — PAID SOCIAL ADS (DTC SUPPLEMENTS)**



We're hiring a video editor to work on paid social ads for one of our DTC supplement brands doing serious volume.



This is not a "stitch clips together" role. We're looking for someone who thinks like a marketer first, editor second. If you've only edited YouTube vlogs, wedding videos, or "aesthetic" reels, this isn't for you.



**THE ROLE**



You'll work directly under a creative strategist who gives you scripts, briefs, and direction. Your job is to execute those concepts at a level where the ad actually sells. The bar is not "looks clean." The bar is "stops the scroll, holds the viewer for 30+ seconds, and drives the click."



You'll also bring your own ad concepts to the table. If your concept goes live and performs, you get a bonus on every winning concept you originate. Editors who think like strategists will print money in this role.



**VOLUME EXPECTATIONS (READ CAREFULLY)**



- Minimum 50 ad concepts per month

- Minimum 2 concepts per day

- This is non-negotiable. The only way to hit this is heavy AI tool use. If you're hand-cutting every frame, you'll never hit the number.



If 50/month sounds insane, do not apply. We've already built the system, the briefs are tight, the asset library is deep, and AI does 60% of the heavy lifting. Your job is to execute fast, not perfect every pixel.



**YOU MUST BE FLUENT IN**



- Direct-response video editing for Meta 
 + Instagram ads, not branded content)

- AI tools, practically not theoretically. We use realistic avatars, AI UGC, AI voiceovers, image and video generation, and whatever new tools drop next week. You should already be using Higgsfield, Veo, Sora, Kling, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Captions, or equivalents daily.

- Hook mechanics, pacing, captions, framing, retention curves

- Building 10-20 variations of a winning ad fast (iteration speed is the whole game)



**WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO**



- Take scripts and briefs from the creative strategist, deliver finished ads

- Hit 2 concepts/day, 50+ per month

- Build variations of winners (different hooks, different opens, different lengths)

- Pitch your own concepts when you see openings

- Document what works, help build SOPs the team can scale

- Sit in weekly creative reviews and apply feedback to next batch



**HARD REQUIREMENTS**



- Real DTC experience. Not "I edited my friend's clothing brand IG." We mean ads that ran on Meta at spend that mattered.

- Working knowledge of what a hook is, why retention drops at 3 seconds, why a captioned word breaks at the wrong syllable kills a scroll.

- Comfortable working fast. If you need three days to deliver one ad, you're in the wrong job.

- Willing to grow, take feedback without ego, and get better every week.



**DO NOT APPLY IF**



- You can't hit 50 concepts/month

- You've never edited a Meta ad that ran on paid traffic

- You think AI tools are "cheating" or you're "still learning them"

- You need NDA excuses to avoid showing real work

- You only do high-polish brand films and hate volume

- You're slow, precious about your edits, or get defensive on feedback



**PAY**



Starting $2,000-$3,000/month based on demonstrated speed and quality. Plus performance bonuses on every winning concept you originate that goes live and scales.



If you crush this role you'll be making more than the base within 90 days from concept bonuses alone.



**HOW TO APPLY**



Send the following or your application gets ignored:



1. A 3-5 minute Loom walking us through 3-5 ads you actually edited. Show the brand, the spend it ran at, the metrics if you have them (CTR, hold rate, ROAS, anything). Talk through WHY you made the editing choices you made, what hook moves you pulled, how you thought about retention.

2. Links to the ads themselves (Meta Ad Library is fine, ad creative files, anything we can watch).

3. One AI-assisted ad you've made recently. We want to see your AI workflow in action, not just the output.

4. Your daily output ceiling. How many ads can you realistically ship per day at your current pace?



No CV-only applications. No "I can't share work because NDA." Real editors have ways to show their work.



---



Couple of strategic notes on this JD before you post it:



**What this filters well:** Volume requirement scares off slow editors. AI requirement filters traditional editors clinging to manual workflows. Loom + actual ad library requirement filters portfolio cosplayers. The "DO NOT APPLY IF" section does most of the screening before you ever read an application.



**What you might want to add depending on where you post it:**

- Timezone overlap requirement (do you need them online during Bangkok hours or just async delivery?)

- Trial structure (most DTC brands run a 1-2 week paid trial at lower rate before committing to full $2-3K)

- Which brand specifically? Naming Blissta might attract better applicants who've seen your ads. Or you might want to keep it confidential to avoid competitor recon. Your call.



**The bigger question:** This role at $2-3K is the right hire if you want execution capacity. But based on what we've talked about, the actual bottleneck is the gap between finished script and winning ad. An editor at $2-3K can fill execution. They will not fix the gap. The Creative Director hire at $10K still does that. So treat this as a parallel hire that frees up your current editor capacity, not a substitute for the CD seat.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and dependable **Executive Assistant** to serve as the operational right hand to the founder of a growing private care platform. This is a role for someone who takes initiative, follows through without reminders, and brings calm structure to a fast-moving, multi-faceted business. The ideal candidate manages multiple priorities simultaneously, communicates clearly, and is comfortable working independently across operations, scheduling, project coordination, and personal executive support.



---



## Key Responsibilities



## Worker Scheduling & Coverage Management



- Manage and maintain worker schedules across approximately 10 active care placements

- Coordinate coverage quickly when care workers call out sick or become unavailable

- Communicate with workers via WhatsApp and other channels to confirm availability and assignments

- Maintain an organized scheduling system to prevent gaps in client care coverage

- Manage and monitor the two WhatsApp worker groups (1,000+ members each) for scheduling updates and announcements



## Project Follow-Up & Web Development Coordination



- Own follow-up with the web developer and any external vendors to ensure projects stay on track and on deadline

- Track open project tasks, deliverables, and timelines — flagging delays and pushing for accountability

- Serve as the communication bridge between the founder and contractors so nothing stalls due to lack of follow-up

- Maintain a project tracker with current status, next steps, and owner for each initiative

- Support the founder’s vision for transitioning the website into a scalable classified care search platform



## Administrative & Operations Support



- Handle invoicing, intake coordination, and client or worker profile checks as needed

- Manage the founder’s inbox, calendar, and daily task list — prioritizing what needs immediate attention

- Coordinate with the existing part-time administrator in Jamaica to provide direction and ensure tasks are completed

- Maintain organized records, files, and operational documentation across all business functions

- Support general business “house cleaning” — identifying and fixing gaps in processes, documentation, and systems



## Personal Executive Assistance



- Provide personal organizational support to help the founder stay focused and on top of priorities

- Manage scheduling across business and personal commitments, ensuring nothing is missed

- Assist with research, drafting communications, and coordinating logistics across multiple business areas

- Support the founder in transitioning out of direct care work by handling tasks that currently require her personal involvement



---



## Requirements



## Essential



- Highly proactive — takes initiative, follows up without being asked, and does not let tasks slip through the cracks

- Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple moving parts across scheduling, admin, and projects simultaneously

- Strong written and verbal communication — clear, professional, and responsive

- Comfortable managing external contractors and holding them accountable to timelines

- Calm and decisive under pressure, especially when managing urgent scheduling coverage needs



## Technical



- Proficiency in WhatsApp for group communication and worker coordination

- Experience with scheduling tools, calendar management, and task tracking systems

- Comfortable with invoicing tools, Google Workspace, or similar administrative platforms

- Familiarity with AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT for productivity and drafting

- Ability to learn and navigate new platforms and systems quickly



## Preferred



- Previous experience in a care staffing, home care, or healthcare administrative environment

- Background supporting a founder or executive in a high-volume, multi-function operational role

- Experience coordinating with remote contractors or managing vendor relationships

- Familiarity with staffing platforms, worker databases, or classified listing sites



To apply, please send your resume and self intro. Failure to comply will not be entertained. Thanks!

title: Strategic Project Manager
description:
This isn’t a typical Project Manager role.



WHO WE ARE

We're Averus Group,  three healthcare companies (Magnolia Hyperbarics, Cerebral Health, and Pacific Neuroscience Center) in the middle of a transformation. We're building real infrastructure across all three: SOPs, optimized workflows, agentic AI tools — the systems that change how the entire operation runs. The vision is clear and the ceiling is exponential. Right now there's one bottleneck: leadership can only move as fast as it can execute alone. That's where you come in.





THE ROLE 

We need a force multiplier. Someone we can hand a vision to — not a task list — who understands the intent, scopes it, builds it out to completion, and coordinates the people needed to make it real. You're fast. You're independent. You don't need to be walked through every step, and you don't stall the second an instruction isn't spelled out.

Your projects could come from any of our three clinics: building an SOP from scratch, streamlining a clinic workflow, standing up an AI process,  and anything in between. You take it, you own it, and you bring back something finished.

You don't need to know everything on day one. But you need to learn fast — fast enough to pick up our AI processes, our Claude Cowork environment, and the agentic tools we're building, and then run with them. You think past the task of why it matters and where it should go, and you bring ideas we didn't ask for. You hold the whole picture across three companies and don't lose the thread when we jump from one problem to the next.

This seat is senior enough to think and own strategy, and wired to execute on command. If you need a seat in every meeting to feel useful, this isn't it. If you'd rather be handed a hard problem and left alone to solve it — keep reading.



WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

Day-to-day, here's what this looks like.

• Take a vision from leadership and build it out to completion — scoping, planning, and delivering finished work

• Own projects end to end across all three clinics — SOPs, streamlining, optimization, AI infrastructure

• Coordinate and guide the staff needed to put your projects into practice, not just hand off a plan

• Build SOPs and drive their adoption in Trainual; train the teams who'll use them

• Learn and run with our AI processes, agentic tools, and Claude Cowork environment, fast

• Manage multiple projects at once and hold context across entities as priorities shift in real time

• Think strategically — bring ideas, improvements, and solutions before they're requested

• Work fluently in Notion, Google Workspace, Asana, and Trainual



YOU'D BE A GREAT FIT IF...

• Have run projects start to finish on your own; concept to delivery

• Are genuinely AI-fluent: you already use modern AI and agentic tools to get real work done

• Learn new systems fast and figure things out without a manual

• Operate with high ownership — you bring back finished work, not a list of questions

• Can coordinate and move other people toward a goal, even ones you don't manage

• Think strategically and see around corners, not just the task in front of you

• Can hold a lot of moving pieces across multiple businesses without dropping any

• Are driven by results and quality, not recognition

• Communicate clearly in writing and work cleanly and independently

• Can reliably work with the U.S. Pacific business hours



Preferred: experience building or supporting AI/automation infrastructure, experience writing SOPs and driving adoption, familiarity with Claude / Claude Cowork and agentic tooling, prior experience supporting a founder or executive directly, and healthcare exposure.



WHAT YOU'LL GET

We take care of the people who take care of our patients.

• Paid Time Off — Recharge so you can perform at your best. We respect the time you take away from work.

• Sick Days — When life happens, it happens. Take the time you need to recover without the pressure.

• Fully Remote — Work remote with a team spread across time zones — autonomy and flexibility built in.

• Real Growth — This is a growing organization. As both brands scale, so do the opportunities for the people building them.

• A Team That Cares — We hire people who are bought into the mission. You'll work alongside others who understand why the work matters, not just what the work is.

• A Greater Mission — Every qualified booking you drive is a patient who gets access to treatment that could change their life. That's not marketing copy — that's the reality of what we do.



If you read this and thought that's exactly the kind of problem I want to own — we'd love to hear from you. Send your resume and a brief note on how you've taken something from idea to finished, start to end.

### Full-Time | Work From Home

---



## About CRT Australia



CRT Australia is a growing Australian disability and community services organisation providing support services to NDIS participants across Australia.



Our mission is to help people live more independently, achieve their goals, and access high-quality support services that improve their quality of life.



We have an extensive database (340 clients ) of previous participants and families who have received services in the past. Many of these clients are no longer actively engaged, creating a significant opportunity to rebuild relationships and reconnect them with services that may benefit them today.



---



## About The Role



We are seeking an exceptional Client Relationship & Business Development Manager to become a key member of our team.



This is not a cold-calling role. This role will commence in 7-14 days. 



You will be contacting previous participants, families, carers and referral sources who already know our organisation. Your role is to rebuild relationships, identify current needs and help reconnect people with the supports and services they require.



You will be responsible for approximately 340 inactive clients and will play a major role in helping grow the organisation.



---



## Key Responsibilities



### Client Relationship Management



* Contact previous participants and families.

* Build genuine long-term relationships.

* Conduct regular follow-up calls.

* Maintain accurate CRM records.

  * Allied Health ( Physio, OT, Speech)

  * Domestic Assistance

---

* Complete CRM notes for all conversations.

* Generate at least 30 meaningful participant conversations.

* Successfully re-engage former participants.

* Create a pipeline of new business opportunities.

* Increase overall participant utilisation.



---



## Essential Requirements



### Must Have



* Excellent spoken and written English.

* Outstanding communication skills.

* Previous sales, customer service or relationship management experience.

* Ability to build rapport quickly.

* Strong organisational skills.

* Reliable internet connection and home office setup.

* Ability to work independently and manage your own workload.



### Highly Desirable



* Previous NDIS experience.

* Healthcare experience.

* Allied Health experience.

* Disability sector experience.

* Community services experience.

* CRM experience.

* Appointment setting experience.

* Business development experience.



---



## The Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who:



* Loves talking to people.

* Builds trust quickly.

* Is highly empathetic.

* Is motivated by helping others.

* Is confident asking for business.

* Enjoys solving problems.

* Wants to be part of a growing Australian organisation.

## Salary & Incentives

AUD $1,500 per month + commissions

### Performance Commissions



Additional commissions paid for:



* Re-engaged participants.

* New participant referrals.

* New service commencements.

* Revenue growth achieved.



High performers will have significant earning potential through the commission structure.

the role will involve a 2 weeks trial period of access to previous 30-40 clients and results will speak for themselves.

title: SEO & SaaS Growth Marketer
description:
# SEO & SaaS Growth Marketer



**Location:** Remote (Philippines)

**Employment:** Full-time



## About GalaBid



GalaBid is a global fundraising software company helping charities, schools and non-profits raise more money through auctions, ticketing, donations and fundraising events.



Our platform is used by thousands of organisations across Australia, New Zealand, the UK, Europe, Canada and the USA. We're a profitable, growing SaaS business with ambitious plans, and we're looking for someone to help us build one of the strongest inbound marketing engines in our industry.



This role reports directly to the founders and offers the opportunity to make a genuine impact on the future growth of the business.



---



# The Opportunity



This isn't a traditional marketing role.



We're not looking for someone to manage agencies, write lengthy marketing plans or spend their days in meetings.



We're looking for someone who enjoys building, testing and improving.



SEO will be the biggest part of your role. We believe organic search is one of our greatest growth opportunities, and we're looking for someone who can help us become the leading authority in fundraising software.



You'll own our organic growth strategy, improve our website, create outstanding content and help convert more visitors into customers.



If you're naturally curious, enjoy analysing data and like seeing the commercial impact of your work, we'd love to hear from you.



---



# What You'll Be Doing



## SEO



You'll take ownership of GalaBid's SEO strategy across multiple countries.



Your responsibilities will include:



* Keyword research and content planning

* Building topic clusters around fundraising, auctions, ticketing and donations

* Creating and optimising landing pages

* Improving existing content

* Monitoring rankings and competitors

* Identifying opportunities through Google Search Console and SEMrush

* Working with developers to improve technical SEO where required



---



## Content Marketing



Create content that attracts qualified visitors and helps customers solve real problems.



This includes:



* Blog articles

* Landing pages

* Comparison pages

* Product pages

* Customer success stories

* Downloadable guides and resources

* Regional content for different countries



We're an AI-first business, so you'll be expected to use tools such as ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity to improve both quality and productivity.



---



## Website & Conversion Optimisation



Our website is one of our most important sales tools.



You'll continually improve:



* Homepage messaging

* Landing pages

* Calls to action

* User journeys

* Website conversion rates

* Demo booking flow

* A/B testing



Working in Webflow, you'll regularly publish new content and improve existing pages.



---



## Product Marketing



Work with our product team to ensure new features are clearly communicated and adopted.



This includes:



* Feature launch pages

* Product announcements

* Release notes

* Customer case studies

* Competitive positioning

* Sales collateral



---



## Customer Growth



Help existing customers get more value from GalaBid.



You'll contribute to improving:



* Customer onboarding

* Product adoption

* Referral programmes

* Reviews and testimonials

* Upsell opportunities



---



## Analytics & Reporting



You'll measure what matters and use data to guide decisions.



You'll regularly monitor:



* Organic traffic

* Keyword rankings

* Website conversion

* Demo bookings

* SaaS revenue

* Customer acquisition

* Customer churn



You'll build simple dashboards and recommend improvements based on performance.



---



# What We're Looking For



We're more interested in what you've achieved than how many years you've worked.



You'll ideally have experience with:



* SEO strategy and execution

* Content marketing

* Writing excellent English

* Webflow or another modern CMS

* Google Search Console

* Google Analytics 4

* SEMrush or Ahrefs

* AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity

* Conversion rate optimisation

* Using data to make commercial decisions



Experience in SaaS, fundraising, event technology or B2B software would be an advantage, but isn't essential.



---



# Tools You'll Use



* Webflow

* Google Search Console

* Google Analytics 4

* SEMrush

* ChatGPT

* Claude

* Perplexity

* Google Workspace



---



# Your First 90 Days



Your first few months will be about understanding the business and building momentum.



We'll expect you to:



* Complete a full SEO and website audit

* Review our competitors and identify opportunities

* Build a prioritised SEO roadmap

* Improve our homepage and key landing pages

* Develop a scalable content plan

* Begin publishing high-quality content consistently

* Introduce simple reporting dashboards so we can measure progress



---



# What Success Looks Like



Within your first year, we'd expect to see:



* Significant growth in qualified inbound leads

* Strong improvement in organic traffic

* Higher rankings for our priority keywords

* Better website conversion rates

* Increased recurring SaaS revenue

* A repeatable SEO and content engine that consistently generates new business



---



# Why Join GalaBid?



* Report directly to the founders and help shape our growth strategy.

This post has specific application instructions at the bottom. If you do not follow them exactly, your application will not be opened. We receive many applications and use the instructions below to identify candidates who pay attention to detail — which is a core requirement of this role.





About Us



We run a TikTok Shop dropshipping store focused on evergreen, problem-solving products — items that address real consumer needs and can be sold year-round, regardless of season. We are building a serious content and product operation and need someone who can own the full process from finding winning products to getting them in front of millions of people.





What You Will Do



Part 1 — Product Research & Validation



You will identify product opportunities from TikTok Shop, AliExpress, and competitor storefronts. Every product you submit must be backed by a completed Excel validation sheet that includes the following:



Market & Demand Signals





TikTok search volume and relevant hashtag traction (e.g., #TikTokMadeMeBuyIt performance)

Number of competing TikTok Shop listings and saturation assessment (red flag: 50+ listings with 500+ reviews using the same content angle)

Google Trends data showing stable or growing year-round demand — no seasonal spikes

Cross-reference with Amazon Movers & Shakers or AliExpress hot products



Financial Viability





AliExpress supplier cost and estimated landed cost

Proposed selling price on TikTok Shop

Gross margin percentage (we target 50%+)

TikTok platform fee estimate (typically 2–8?pending on category)

Estimated net profit per unit after fees and affiliate commission budget



Virality & Content Signals



Number of videos with 100K+ views featuring this product in the last 30 days

Video save rate and share rate on top-performing product content

Frequency of buyer-intent comments ("where can I buy this?", "link?")

Whether multiple creators are filming the same product in different formats (signals scalability)

Watch-through rate benchmarks pulled from TikTok Creative Center

title: Short-Form Series Producer — Vertical Drama (TikTok & Reels)
description:
## Short-Form Series Producer — Vertical Drama (TikTok & Reels)



**Location:** Fully remote · **Type:** Full-time · **Compensation:** Base + performance bonus tied to growth (see below) · **Reports to:** Founder



### About us



We're a stealth-stage narrative studio. We make and grow **serialized vertical drama** — DramaBox / ReelShort / micro-drama-style short-form storytelling built to hook in three seconds and keep people bingeing. This is not brand content and not advertising. It's drama, cut for the vertical feed.



### The role



You own the *growth and packaging* of our short-form drama accounts — the strategy, the hooks, the publishing, the data. You'll launch accounts from zero, shape what gets made and how it's framed for the feed, and engineer the hooks and cliffhangers that make people watch to the end and come back for the next part. You work hand-in-hand with our editor, who handles the cutting — you bring the plan and the brief, she brings the craft. You're equal parts storyteller and analyst: strong instincts for dramatic pacing, and you live in the retention data to know exactly where viewers drop and why. Read the "what we're looking for" section carefully; **when you apply, open your message with the word "CLIFFHANGER"** so we know you did. This is an ownership role: you set the content strategy, you ship daily, and you're measured on results.



### What you'll do



- Launch, run, and grow multiple TikTok and Instagram accounts publishing serialized vertical drama from a standing start.

- Own the content strategy: what series we make, how episodes are structured, and how each one is hooked and packaged for the feed.

- Brief and direct our editor — hand off clear cut directions, hook requirements, and episode beats, then refine based on what the data says.

- Engineer 3-second hooks, episode cliffhangers, and series structures that drive completion, saves, shares, and return viewers.

- Natively publish at volume and manage posting cadence, captions, hooks, and community engagement to compound reach.

- Read the data daily — retention curves, drop-off points, completion, follower velocity — and rapidly iterate.

- Stay ahead of micro-drama trends, formats, audio, and algorithm shifts and translate them into our content fast.



### What we're looking for



- A demonstrable track record growing **serialized or episodic** short-form accounts — bring the accounts and the real numbers (retention, completion, followers gained). Brand ads, product promos, and UGC ad spots are **not** what we're hiring for; please don't send them.

- Native fluency in narrative short-form: you understand hooks, cliffhangers, dramatic pacing, and binge mechanics by instinct *and* by data.

- A sharp eye for packaging and direction — you can articulate exactly why a cut works and brief an editor to nail it, even though you're not the one cutting.

- Genuinely data-literate: you make calls from retention curves, not vibes.

- High output, high iteration speed — you'd rather ship 20 tests and learn than polish one.

- Fully self-directed in a remote setting.



### Nice to have



- Experience with vertical micro-drama specifically (DramaBox, ReelShort, GoodShort, or similar platforms).

- On-camera or talent-direction experience.

- Scriptwriting for serialized formats.



### Compensation



- Competitive base **plus** a performance bonus tied to growth milestones (follower and qualified-reach targets per account). We deliberately weight pay toward upside — make the accounts grow, earn more.



### To apply



Reply with: (1) links to **serialized** accounts you've grown and the numbers behind them, (2) the opening hook of your best episode and the cliffhanger that ended it, and (3) one micro-drama series you think nails the format, and why. *(Applications without serialized examples won't be reviewed.)*

title: Sales Auditor and Coach
description:
WHO WE ARE



Averus Group is a healthcare management services organization (MSO) based in the Bay Area. We provide the operational backbone — systems, training, marketing, finance, and shared services — that lets our specialty clinics focus on delivering exceptional patient care. You won't be contracted to any single clinic; you'll be part of the Averus team that builds and runs the engine behind all of them.



Two of those clinics anchor this role:

• Cerebral Health is a specialty chiropractic neurology clinic focused on concussion, TBI, vestibular, and autonomic disorders — helping patients who've often been failed by the conventional system finally get answers and recover.

• Magnolia Hyperbarics is our hyperbaric oxygen therapy practice serving members and partners across the region.



Across both, the consultation and report-of-finding conversations aren't just clinical exchanges — they're the 
nt a patient d
 to invest in getting their life back. We're building a world-class sales enablement engine to make sure every one of those conversations is exceptional, and we're looking for the person to own it.





THE ROLE 



This is not a closing or quota-carrying sales role. You won't be selling to patients. Your core job is to make our clinicians dramatically better at the consultative conversations that turn prospective patients into committed ones.

You'll live inside an AI-powered sales workspace, audit clinical sales conversations against proven frameworks, and deliver sharp, usable coaching straight to our doctors — holding them accountable to a high standard and tracking their improvement over time. The large majority of this work is for Cerebral Health, with a smaller portion supporting Magnolia Hyperbarics calls and check-ins.

Alongside the coaching work, you'll support our marketing team and Director of Operations on sales-driven initiatives and outreach. This is a supporting part of the role, not the center of it — the heart of the job is auditing and coaching.

Think of yourself as the coach, the quality engine, and the systems-builder behind our sales conversations. Much of this is heads-down precision work — auditing, scoring, refining — paired with the people's skill to coach skilled professionals in a way that actually changes behavior.



WHAT YOU’LL OWN

Day-to-day, here's what this looks like.

• Call & transcript auditing. Review consultation, report-of-findings, and reevaluation conversations (primarily Cerebral Health, plus Magnolia check-ins) against our sales frameworks and scripts. Catch the small misses — the unasked pain question, the weak transition, the rushed close — that separate a good consult from a converting one.

• Coaching & accountability. Deliver weekly, specific, actionable feedback directly to our clinical team. Hold doctors accountable to standards, track improvement over time, and make hard feedback land in a way that actually changes behavior.

• AI workspace management. Operate, maintain, and continuously improve our AI-powered sales enablement workspace — running transcripts through it, refining prompts and rubrics, and strategically upgrading the system so its feedback gets sharper over time.

• Protocol adherence & refinement. Follow established workspace protocols precisely, while constantly looking for ways to make them better.

• Sales & marketing support. Partner with the marketing team and Director of Operations on sales-driven initiatives, and support Magnolia Hyperbarics with outreach and backend marketing work.



YOU'D BE A GREAT FIT IF...

• Detail-obsessed. You notice the things other people skim past. Nitpicky is a compliment to you.

• AI-native. You don't just "use ChatGPT" — you build, troubleshoot, and improve AI systems. You can own a workspace and make it better over time.

• A natural coach. You can take a messy conversation, identify the three things that mattered, and deliver that feedback so a skilled professional accepts it instead of getting defensive.

• Sales-literate. You may not have carried a quota, but you can recognize a strong discovery sequence, a missed pain point, and a clean close. You're a great judge of selling.

• Strategic. You think about the system, not just the task. You're always asking how to make the engine better.

• A strong communicator. Clear, direct, and warm. You build trust and authority with people who outrank you in their own domain.



MUST-HAVES

• Demonstrated experience in sales enablement, sales coaching/training, call QA, or a closely related role

• Hands-on fluency with AI tools — be ready to walk us through a workspace or AI system you personally set up and refined

• Strong feedback and coaching ability with professionals or experts

• Exceptional attention to detail and a systems mindset

• Excellent written and verbal English communication

• Ability to work full-time on Pacific Time hours, regardless of physical location

• Reliable workspace, hardware, and internet

title: IT Support Analyst (On-site) Davao City
description:
Job description:



The Technical Support Specialist provides Tier 1 technical support to customers experiencing issues with their VoIP phone systems and network connectivity services. This is a fast-paced role that involves managing support requests via phone,
, and ticketing systems.



Key Responsibilities



The specialist is the frontline expert responsible for diagnosing and resolving a wide range of issues.



VoIP/PBX System Support

-Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex issues related to VoIP (Voice over IP), SIP (Session Initiation Protocol), and PBX (Private Branch Exchange) systems (both physical and cloud-based like FreePBX, 3CX, or Cisco CUCM).

-Assist with the provisioning, configuration, and deployment of new VoIP handsets, soft phones, and system extensions.

-Resolve common call quality issues, such as jitter, latency, and echo, often requiring the analysis of call logs or packet captures (Wireshark).



Network and Connectivity Troubleshooting

-Troubleshoot network issues impacting voice communication quality, including local area network (LAN) and wide area network (WAN) connectivity.

-Configure and troubleshoot customer-side network devices like routers, modems, and firewalls to ensure proper Quality of Service (QoS) and port forwarding for VoIP traffic.

-Provide support for network fundamentals such as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and VLANs.



Ticketing and Documentation

-Accurately log, track, and manage customer issues using a ticketing system (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow, Zendesk).

-Create and maintain high-quality internal and customer facing documentation (knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides).

-Escalate unresolved issues to senior engineering or infrastructure teams when necessary.



Required Qualifications:

-Associate’s or Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

-Experience in a 24/7 support environment and willingness to work rotational shifts and holidays.

-1+ year experience deploying and/or testing VoIP systems or solutions\

-1+ year experience in telecommunications

-1+ years isolating and repairing VoIP system faults/misconfigurations and/or determining interoperability issues

-Experience with TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routers and IP routing, and switches

-Familiarity with VoIP devices, i.e. Linksys PAP2, SPA 9000, and “soft phones”

-Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and customer service skills

-Good written and verbal communication skills in English

-Certifications/Licenses: Relevant technical certifications (CCNA, CompTIA Network+,

-CompTIA A+, or specific vendor certifications for Cisco, Microsoft, or VoIP platforms)



Preferred Skills

-Experience with cloud-hosted PBX platforms (e.g., FreePBX, 3CX, RingCentral, Sangoma).

-Familiarity with Wireshark, network analyzers, and SIP troubleshooting tools.

-Ability to manage high call volumes and multitask effectively in a fast-paced support environment.



Core Competencies

-Exceptional problem-solving and analytical abilities for effective root cause analysis.

-Outstanding verbal and written communication skills to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical users with patience and clarity.

-Customer-Centric Focus with a commitment to delivering high-quality service and timely resolutions.

-Ability to prioritize and manage multiple simultaneous tasks in a high-pressure, dynamic environment.



Technical Skills

-Expert knowledge of VoIP protocols (e.g., SIP, RTP, Codecs) and their role in telecommunications.

-Proven experience with PBX/Unified Communications platforms (e.g., Asterisk, FreePBX, Cisco, Avaya).

-Strong foundation in networking fundamentals (CompTIA Network+ or CCNA level knowledge).

-Experience troubleshooting modem and router configurations for various internet service types.

-Familiarity with network diagnostic tools like ping, traceroute, and packet sniffers.

-Proficiency with operating systems like Windows and Linux CLI (Command Line Interface) for system checks and management.

You will own a defined block of our catalog (starting with extension cords, our largest category) like a P&L. You will know your category and your top competitors cold, watch your listings every day, and make the pricing, inventory, and advertising calls that protect rank and margin.



This is a judgment and ownership role. Not data entry. Not catalog cleanup. Not dashboard watching.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



- Category P&L: in-stock rate, contribution margin, TACOS, and category profit. You run it like an owner.

- Daily monitoring of your top SKUs: competitor pricing, deals and lightning deals, stock positions, Buy Box, and listing health.

- Pricing decisions within a clear rule set, including our low-stock governor (when a winner runs low, you d
 whether to raise price or pull ad spend to protect rank instead of going out of stock).

- In-stock discipline on core winners, working with forecasting and sourcing so proven sellers are never starved.

- Listing quality: titles, images, A+ content, variations, and pack configurations.

- Liquidation calls on end-of-life and slow-moving inventory.

- Channel growth: extend your winners onto Walmart, Shopify, and Canada.

- SOPs and decision trees that make the role scalable and repeatable.



WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT



It is not a data-entry or backend-keyword role.

It is not a catalog cleanup role.

It is not dashboard monitoring and forwarding problems to someone else.

It is not inventory forecasting.

It is not creative design.

It is not for someone who waits to be told what to do.



We already have catalog, compliance, inventory, creative, and operations support. We need someone who connects the dots and drives the action.



WHAT YOU WILL BE MEASURED ON



- High in-stock rate on A and B SKUs, with no preventable stockouts on winners

- Contribution margin and category profit

- TACOS and advertising efficiency

- Days out of stock trending down over time

- Underperforming SKUs turned into clear, documented action plans

- Channel growth against revenue and margin goals



WHAT YOU NEED



- 3+ years running an Amazon Seller Central account, ideally owning a category or P&L

- Fluency in Amazon fees, FBA economics, Buy Box dynamics, and pricing. You can calculate a SKU's contribution margin in your sleep.

- Strong commercial judgment. You d
 and own outcomes, you do not wait to be told.

- Comfort with Helium 10 or similar, Seller Central reporting, and spreadsheets

- Excellent written English and proactive remote communication

- Ability to build and improve SOPs, checklists, and decision trees

- Walmart Marketplace a strong plus. Shopify or Canada a plus.

- Bonus: home, hardware, electrical, or commodity consumable categories

- Single full-time commitment, no other clients or roles



YOUR AUTHORITY



- Set pricing within the rule set, including low-stock governor calls

- Make in-stock and liquidation decisions for your block

- Create action plans and coordinate fixes across catalog, creative, inventory, compliance, and operations

- Recommend listing, pricing, assortment, and channel improvements

- Escalate true exceptions with clear context and a recommendation



GROWTH PATH



Category Merchant to Senior Category Merchant / Marketplace Manager to Channel Lead / Marketplace Operations Lead.



We promote from within and reward ownership, judgment, and measurable results.



WHAT WE OFFER



- Competitive pay plus performance bonuses

- 100% remote

- Paid time off

- A real growth path

- Real P&L ownership of an important category

- A lean, high-performance team that values judgment, speed, and accountability



IMPORTANT NOTES



- No freelancers carrying other clients, no part-time

- Full commitment, no other roles

- Gross pay, candidate handles their own taxes



HOW TO APPLY



To be considered,
 your resume to 
 with the subject line:

Category Merchant: [Your Name]



In the body of your
, answer these three questions:



1. Briefly describe your hands-on experience managing e-commerce marketplace accounts (Amazon Seller Central, Walmart, Shopify, or international channels), including any time you owned a category or P&L.



2. Tell us about a time you spotted an underperforming SKU or channel from reports or dashboards. What did you notice, what action did you take, and what was the result?



3. Give an example of a time you coordinated with catalog, inventory, creative, operations, or leadership to fix a marketplace issue. How did you drive it?



Applications sent any other way, or missing answers to all three questions, will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will complete one short practical exercise before final review.



We are moving fast. Strong candidates will hear back quickly.

title: Amazon PPC Growth Lead
description:
Amazon PPC Growth Lead



About the Role

We are hiring an Amazon PPC Growth Lead to own advertising strategy and performance across a portfolio of Amazon brands.

This is not a maintenance role. 

We are not looking for someone who simply adjusts bids, checks budgets, and waits for instructions. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of PPC as a growth function inside the business.

If you are used to brand managers specifically telling you which products to raise budgets on and by how much, this is not the role for you. 

You will analyze the performance, know the brands inside and out, talk to the clients directly, collaborate with the brand manager on joint strategy, and advise on the strategy necessary to drive the growth.

The right person knows how to analyze performance, identify what matters, create a plan, and communicate clearly with clients. They understand that Amazon advertising is not just about ACoS. It is about revenue, profitability, ranking, product growth, budget allocation, conversion, and total business performance.

You should be the person who sees what is happening before the client asks. You bring ideas. You find problems. You recommend action. You follow through.

Clients should feel confident that you understand their business and are actively leading the advertising strategy forward.

You must be comfortable organizing and presenting data and analysis to the client, explaining your analysis and decision making and talking for a 1 hour PPC meeting 4-5 times per week.

We are building a growth oriented agency with the longer term goal of launching our own products. 



What You’ll Own

You will own PPC strategy and performance for assigned Amazon accounts.

That means you will:

Build and manage Amazon PPC strategies that support client growth goals

Analyze performance across campaigns, products, keywords, search terms, budgets, and profitability

Identify opportunities to grow revenue, improve efficiency, reduce waste, and scale what is working

Explain what is happening in the account, why it is happening, and what should happen next

Bring proactive recommendations to clients and internal teams

Create action plans for underperforming areas and follow through until there is a result

Connect PPC performance to broader business drivers like conversion rate, pricing, inventory, reviews, organic rank, margin, and product lifecycle

Communicate strategy clearly so clients trust that their business is being actively managed

Stay current on Amazon Ads changes, new opportunities, testing strategies, and competitive shifts



What Success Looks Like

Success in this role is not measured by whether you “touched” campaigns or adjusted bids.

Success is measured by whether you are helping move the client’s business forward.

You are successful when:

Clients feel confident that PPC is being owned, not maintained

You bring smart recommendations before being asked

You can clearly explain performance, risks, opportunities, and next steps

Accounts become stronger, cleaner, more strategic, and more scalable under your ownership

PPC decisions are tied to business outcomes, not just campaign metrics

You identify problems early and come with solutions

You know when to push for growth, when to protect profitability, and when to challenge the current strategy

Your work creates visible impact on revenue, profitability, efficiency, or client confidence



What We Do Not Want

This role is not a fit for someone who:

Is used to spending most of your time raising and lowering bids

Waits to be told what to do

Runs mostly auto and category campaigns

Reports high level aggregated numbers without diving into the details and explaining what they mean

Thinks ACoS is the only metric that matters

Avoids accountability for business outcomes

Needs someone else to create the strategy

Does the minimum required campaign work and calls it optimization

Uses AI or Automation to do the majority of the work.

We need someone who thinks, owns, communicates, and drives.



Responsibilities

Own Amazon PPC strategy across assigned client accounts

Manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, and Sponsored Display campaigns

Analyze account performance and identify growth, efficiency, and profitability opportunities

Build campaign structures that support scale, control, and clear decision-making

Manage keyword strategy, search term harvesting, negatives, placements, budgets, and bid strategy

Develop testing plans for new campaigns, products, keywords, placements, creative, and budget strategies

Review performance trends and create clear action plans

Prepare client-facing insights, recommendations, and strategic updates

Partner with account managers and leadership to align PPC strategy with client business goals

Identify when non-PPC issues are impacting performance, including pricing, inventory, reviews, conversion rate, content, or competition

Communicate risks and opportunities early, with recommended next steps

Must be highly competent managing accounts with over $100k/mo advertising budgets.



Goals for This Role

The goal of this role is simple:

Make clients trust that their Amazon advertising is being actively led by someone who understands the business.

You will be expected to:

Drive profitable growth where opportunity exists

Improve inefficient or underperforming accounts

Build client trust through clear strategic communication

Create proactive recommendations that lead to action

Make PPC strategy easier for clients and internal teams to understand

Turn data into decisions

Own outcomes, not just tasks



Requirements

3+ years of hands-on Amazon PPC experience

Must be able to run accounts manually.

Must also be familiar with Pacvue

Strong understanding of Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, and Sponsored Display

Deep knowledge of ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, CVR, CPC, CTR, keyword strategy, campaign structure, and profitability

Ability to analyze data and turn it into clear recommendations

Strong communication skills, especially when explaining performance and strategy

Experience managing multiple Amazon accounts or brands

Ability to work independently and take ownership without constant direction

Strong judgment around growth, efficiency, budget allocation, and profitability tradeoffs



Preferred Experience

Experience working in an agency or multi-client environment

Experience with Amazon reporting tools, PPC software, or business intelligence dashboards

Experience presenting strategy directly to clients or senior stakeholders

Understanding of Amazon SEO, product launches, ranking strategy, promotions, and catalog performance



Who Will Thrive Here

You will thrive in this role if you are used to driving a business forward with ad strategies. You are analytical, creative, and accountable. 

You like digging into accounts and figuring out what is really going on. You are not satisfied with surface-level reporting. You want to know what is working, what is broken, where the opportunity is, and what should happen next.

You do not need to be micromanaged. You want ownership. You want to be trusted. You want your recommendations to matter.

Most importantly, you understand that great PPC management is not maintenance.

It is leadership.

title: Remote Bookkeeper/Executive Assistant
description:
Haz-Ed Services Pty Ltd is a Western Australian business headquartered in Wangara, Perth. We operate across several divisions, including nationally recognised workplace safety training, height safety system installation and recertification, equipment supply, and servicing.



Our clients range from state government and local councils to major commercial operators across Perth metro and regional Western Australia.



We are growing and need a highly skilled Bookkeeper/Executive Assistant based in the Philippines to join our remote team.



This role will begin as an initial part-time engagement of approximately 15–20 hours per week, with the possibility of moving to full-time if there is a good long-term fit.



We are looking for someone who can bring financial discipline, high-level administrative support, and genuine ownership to a fast-moving business.



The right person will be able to support the numbers, the Director, and the day-to-day operating rhythm of the business.





About The Role



As our Remote Bookkeeper / Executive Assistant, you will play a key role in keeping Haz-Ed financially organised, operationally efficient, and well supported at the Director level.



This is a hybrid role.



On the bookkeeping side, you will manage day-to-day accounts, reconciliations, reporting, payroll support, BAS/IAS preparation support, debtor follow-up, and financial record keeping.



On the executive assistance side, you will work directly with the Director to manage inbox priorities, calendar coordination, communications, follow-ups, SOPs, documentation, reporting, and administrative systems.



You will need to be confident working across both detail-heavy financial tasks and fast-moving executive support.



The right person will be highly organised, proactive, accurate, discreet, and able to keep important tasks moving without needing constant reminders.



Working hours: Perth business hours, AWST / UTC+8

Engagement: Full-time, long-term





Key Responsibilities



Bookkeeping and Finance

* Day-to-day bookkeeping using Xero

* Accounts payable and accounts receivable management

* Daily and weekly bank reconciliations

* Payroll processing support

* Quarterly BAS and monthly IAS preparation and lodgement support

* Australian GST, BAS, and PAYG-related bookkeeping support

* Cash flow forecasting and budget tracking

* Financial reporting, including P&L, Balance Sheet, aged debtors, and aged creditors

* Invoice generation, client follow-up, and debtor management

* Supporting project-based job costing for installation works

* Training division revenue tracking

* Document management — organised, audit-ready filing

* Ad hoc financial analysis as directed by the Director



Executive Assistance and Director Support

* Inbox management, including triaging
s, flagging priorities, drafting responses, and following up on outstanding items

* Calendar management, including scheduling meetings, coordinating availability, and helping the Director stay prepared

* Communication support across clients, suppliers, contractors, internal tea
mbers, and external stakeholders

* Preparing, formatting, and maintaining reports, spreadsheets, presentations, and business documents

* Tracking action items, deadlines, decisions, and follow-ups after meetings or Director's instructions

* Creating, updating, and organising SOPs, checklists, process documents, and internal records

* Maintaining organised digital files, folders, and document management systems

* Assisting with CRM, database, and admin system updates

* Supporting internal communication so tasks do not get lost between departments

* Helping improve administrative workflows and business systems

* Handling confidential business and financial information with professionalism

* Providing ad hoc operational and executive support as directed by the Director





What We’re Looking For



Essential

* Minimum 5 years of bookkeeping, accounting, finance administration, or similar experience

* Strong Executive Assistant or senior administrative support experience

* Proven experience managing inboxes, calendars, communications, documents, and follow-ups for a business owner, Director, or senior leader

* Xero certified or highly proficient in Xero

* Demonstrated experience with Australian business accounting, including GST, BAS, and PAYG

* Strong understanding of accounts payable, accounts receivable, reconciliations, payroll support, and financial reporting

* Experience supporting Australian clients or Australian businesses remotely

* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

* Strong attention to detail and numerical accuracy

* Excellent organisation, prioritisation, and follow-through

* Ability to work independently and keep tasks moving without constant supervision

* Ability to manage confidential information with care

* Reliable internet connection and a professional home office setup

* Availability during Perth business hours, AWST / UTC+8



Highly Regarded

* Experience supporting Australian trade, construction, equipment, safety, or training sector businesses

* Familiarity with payroll for Australian contractors and employees

* Experience with job costing, project tracking, or division-based reporting

* Experience preparing management reports or financial summaries

* Strong skills in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets

* Experience creating SOPs, process documents, or internal admin systems

* Experience working directly with a founder, Director, or business owner in a remote environment

* Confidence communicating with suppliers, clients, contractors, and internal tea
mbers





Our Culture and Values



At Haz-Ed, everything we do is grounded in six core values:



* Think Safe, Be Safe — safety is not a department, it is how we operate

* Accountability Through Commitment — we own our work and deliver on our word

* Respect and the Team — we back each other and treat everyone with respect

* Quality Driven — we do not cut corners; quality outcomes are the standard

* Efficiency Comes by Being Smart — we work smarter, not just harder

* Open and Honest — clear communication, no surprises



We expect our remote tea
mbers to live these values, too.

If you are reliable, organised, honest, accurate, proactive, and take pride in doing quality work, you will fit right in.



Compensation and Engagement Terms



We pay highly competitive rates to attract and retain top talent.



Rates reflect the candidate's experience, Xero proficiency, knowledge of Australian accounting requirements, and proven Executive Assistant capability.

.



Why Join Haz-Ed



* Stable, long-term engagement with a growing WA business — we are not a revolving door

* Direct working relationship with the Director — no layers of bureaucracy

* Real variety: government and commercial clients, project and recurring work

* A team that takes safety, quality, and accountability seriously

* Professional development opportunities as the business scales

* On-time payment — always





How To Apply



To be considered, please submit the following:



* Updated CV or resume with full employment history

* Cover letter addressing your Xero experience and Australian client background, together with the summary of your Executive Assistant experience

* Your available start date & your preferred working hours

title: Sales Representative
description:
Join a fast-growing US online home goods retailer and enjoy the learning and opportunities that you have while working with us.



We strive to provide 5-star service & shopping assistance to all of our clients, and all of our team is accountable to fulfill this.



We are looking for a Sales Representative who can assist prospective buyers and close online ecommerce sales.



We're only looking for full-time, long-term, ongoing cooperation.



Work schedules available:

8 AM to 4 PM US EST

4 PM to 12 AM US EST



Your work week will be 5 days per week, with 2 days off per week. Days off will be selected with your manager. We will try to accommodate your preferences for which days you like, based on availability.



This role starts ASAP.



Job Duties and Responsibilities:

Receive incoming phone calls and live chats from potential customers (prospects) who indicated that they need shopping assistance. This does not include calls and chats from existing customers that need help with their orders (that’s a job for a different department)

Makes follow-up calls, writes follow-up
s, and text messages to potential buyers. We try to follow up 5x with each person that contacted us (unless they indicate that they are no longer interested). We don’t do cold calling. Only reaching out to prospects who interacted with our online store and left their contact information.

After each interaction with a prospect/customer, writes notes & comments in our CRM (Asana)

Communicate efficiently and build rapport with potential customers

Assists prospects in their shopping journey and helps make the purchase decision

Ensures that all prospects’ questions and objections are addressed

Leads every interaction to a close sale, which means an order is placed on our online store

Prepares custom quotes, price matches competitors if necessary, and offers custom discounts. This requires calculating margins & ensuring profitability.

Answering questions about the products we offer, including technical questions. Learns the specifications, features and benefits of our bestsellers. Over time, becomes an expert in the industry.

If not able to answer product-specific questions, conducts research in the materials provided by the supplier, or reaches out to the supplier to get the information

Confirms stock availability and lead times when offering products to prospects

Documents standard procedures and best practices in a written form, so that other tea
mbers can learn from them



Requirements:

At least 2 years of experience in sales on the phone

Experience must include both inbound and outbound sales

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

Experience in Customer Service on the phone is a nice to have

Experience in the e-commerce (online shopping) industry is nice to have

Home improvement, construction, and gas plumbing industry experience is a plus

Outgoing, friendly, and lively

Can-do mindset, with a sense of ownership, pride in your performance, and its impact on the company’s success

Long-term commitment - treat this as your career



What we can offer:

Sales commission: 8% of gross profit from all orders closed. Gross profit means the sale amount minus the product and shipping costs. Paid monthly. No upper limit. Monthly commission payouts range between $1,200 (the guaranteed minimum) and as high as $3,000 (for the top performer). The average monthly payout is $1,465 (average from the last 2 years).

$1,200/month minimum guaranteed pay

15 days paid days off per year (also convertible to min. guaranteed commission)

Paid training on all aspects of the role

Opportunities for professional development

Friendly atmosphere

Online Interview process

Fully remote position

title: Patient Billing Specialist -- US Dermatology Practice
description:
We are a growing US based dermatology practice looking for an experienced medical billing specialist to handle patient billing questions and insurance follow-up by phone and message. Patients call us confused or upset about their statements, and insurance companies need to be chased on claims -- we want someone who can calmly explain a bill to a worried patient and also hold their own on the phone with an insurance representative to get a claim resolved.



What matters most to us is common sense, maturity, and the ability to work independently -- billing is full of judgment calls and dead-end insurance phone trees, and we need someone who keeps pushing, thinks for themselves, and does the right thing without being told. We value this above all else. Dermatology billing experience is a plus, but we would much rather have a mature, independent, sharp biller with general medical billing experience than a dermatology specialist who needs hand-holding.



You must have real US medical billing experience (patient statements, claims, denials, EOBs, and insurance follow-up), excellent spoken and written English, a reliable high-speed internet connection, a quiet place to take calls, and a working headset. You will work US East Coast hours, which is an evening/overnight shift in the Philippines -- please only apply if that schedule works for you long term.



If you are interested in this position, please send me an
 with your resume and answer the following questions:



1. What are your preferred hours of work/availability?

2. How many hours per week would you like to work -- minimum and maximum?

3. Describe your medical billing experience -- what billing/RCM software you have used and what kinds of billing you handled (patient statements, claims, denials, insurance follow-up).

4. Tell me about a time you handled a difficult situation on your own, with no one available to ask for help -- what happened and what you did.

5. Will you be working with me directly, or are you part of an agency? Will you be delegating any of your work to another VA?

6. What experience, if any, do you have in dermatology billing? If none, what is the closest related experience you have and how is it relevant?

7. When is the soonest you can begin work?



To be considered, please begin your response with the words "Let's sort it out!" and answer each question above in order.

title: VA Issue Coordinator (Property Maintenance & Operations)
description:

    Mon-Fri: 10am - 6pm (with 1 hour break daily) - 35 hours

Role Description



The Issue Coordinator is a specialized role focused on streamlining property maintenance, emergency response, and issue resolution. The primary objective is to resolve property-related issues efficiently while maintaining a comprehensive knowledge base for the entire team on the properties, and efficient communication with the property owner.

Primary Responsibilities:

The primary responsibilities can change from time to time, based on the requirements of the business.  



The On-Call System (24/7 Coverage): 

This role operates on a Primary/Secondary Roster to ensure round-the-clock emergency support.



    Primary: Must be fully available for emergencies during assigned shifts.



    Secondary: Acts strictly as an emergency backup.



    Accountability: Reliability is critical. Failure to fulfill Primary duties is a severe breach of role.



    Duty Swaps: Coordination of shift switches is the responsibility of the staff members.



Candidate Requirements:

title: Personal Assistant (Remote) — Founder Support
description:
Do not apply without reading



About the role

I'm a busy founder and I need a sharp, reliable personal assistant to take the small-but-constant stuff off my plate: inbox triage, calendar, scheduling, travel, research, reminders, and follow-ups. The job is 20% tasks and 80% judgment — I need someone who thinks two steps ahead and never drops a ball.



What you'll do



Triage my inbox and draft replies in my voice

Own my calendar: book, reschedule, protect my focus time

Book travel and handle the logistics around it

Research and summarize (vendors, options, quick answers) so I can d
 fast

Track my to-dos and chase the things I forget

Handle the occasional personal errand done online

Must-haves



2+ years as an assistant or in a role where you owned someone's schedule

Excellent written English — you'll be writing as me

Fluent in Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Sheets)

A few hours of daily overlap with US Pacific time

Discreet with private information, and reliable to the minute

Nice-to-haves



Experience supporting a founder or executive

Comfortable with Slack and Asana

You spot problems before they reach me

How to apply — read carefully



Make the first word of your application TANGERINE. Applications without it are deleted unread.

In 3–4 sentences, tell me about a time you fixed a problem before you were asked to.

Rewrite this so it's polite but still firm — paste your version:

"You've moved our meeting twice and I'm not rearranging my week a third time."

A scenario: I'm double-booked at 2pm — a customer call and a vendor demo, both important. I'm in back-to-backs and can't be reached for an hour. What do you do? (Answer in a few sentences.)

List your tools, your weekly availability in US Pacific, and your hourly rate in USD.

Paid test (final step)

Shortlisted applicants get one small paid task: I'll send a messy set of details and ask you to book a (mock) dinner reservation, send a clean calendar invite with two backup options, and a 3-line summary. We pay for your time whether or not we hire you.



Pay & hours: [TBD — see my question below]



The hurdles and what each screens out:



"TANGERINE" first word ? kills mass-appliers who don't read. (Use a different word than the designer post so you can tell the two pools apart.)

"Fixed a problem before asked" ? screens for proactivity, the #1 trait that separates a great PA from a task-taker.

Rewrite the rude
 ? tests written English and tone in the actual job's medium. This is your single best filter for a PA.

The 2pm double-booking scenario ? tests judgment and decisiveness under ambiguity. Bad hires freeze or ask you; good ones triage and act.

Paid test task ? real execution under real messiness. Can't be faked.

One question so I can set pay and scope: is this business-only (inbox, calendar, travel, research) or also personal life-admin (your appointments, family stuff, errands)? That changes the trust level, the hours, and how the post reads.
