title: Senior Content Strategist
description:
About She's Making Millions

She's Making Millions is a fast-growing brand and movement helping ambitious women scale their businesses, elevate their influence, and build wealth with purpose. We run world-class events (including SMM Live, our flagship conference in November 2026), The Boardroom (our strategic advisory experience), and The She's Making Millions Podcast. Our audience is sharp, ambitious, and pays attention. Our content has to be sharper.



The Role in One Line

You own the content strategy and the creative direction. You come up with the ideas that go viral, you d
 what we make, and you hand the brief to the execution team. You do not produce or schedule. You think, direct, and grow.



Why We're Hiring

We have a strong execution team, a brand voice that lands, and a high-intent audience. What we don't have is a world-class strategic mind owning content. We need someone who can take this brand from "good content" to "the content women in business save, share, and quote". Specifically, we need someone who can deliver the audience and ticket sales for SMM Live in November 2026.



Primary Focus Areas



1. Own the rolling 90-day content strategy across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and
..

2. Concept and direct viral content (reels, shorts, hook-driven posts) that grows our following and engagement..

3. Lead the content side of the SMM Live campaign: build the strategy that fills the room..

4. Direct the marketing team on what to make, when, and why..

5. Track what's working, iterate fast, kill what isn't..



Key Responsibilities



Strategy

• Build and own a rolling 90-day content strategy with clear monthly themes and weekly content pillars..

• Set the growth targets per platform and the strategy to hit them..

• D
 what content series we run, what we kill, and when to pivot..

• Lead the content strategy for SMM Live (Nov 2026), Yacht Party, Scaling Secrets, and Boardroom enrolment campaigns..



Creative Direction

• Concept viral-worthy content ideas weekly: hooks, formats, angles, talking points..

• Brief the video editor on what to film, how to cut, and what to lead with..

• Brief designers on visual direction for carousels and graphics..

• Brief the marketing assistant on what needs to be scheduled, posted, and how..

• Stay relentlessly on top of platform trends, viral formats, and audience behaviour..



Performance & Iteration

• Analyse content performance weekly: what's working, what's not, why..

• Iterate the strategy in real time based on data..

• Report monthly to the founder with metrics, insights, and the next 30-day plan..



Event Promotion

• Build the multi-month content runway for SMM Live and other major events..

• Concept the campaign hooks, sequencing, and content drops that drive ticket sales..

• Coordinate with the ads manager so paid and organic work as one campaign, not two..



What Success Looks Like (first 90 days)

• A documented 90-day content strategy delivered in your first two weeks..

• At least 2 pieces of content that hit viral metrics (1M+ views, or top 1% reach for the brand) within the first 60 days..

• Measurable follower and engagement growth across at least two platforms..

• A confirmed content runway and creative plan for the SMM Live campaign..

• Clear weekly briefs handed to the execution team so nothing stalls..



Required Experience

• Proven track record growing social media accounts (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube) to 100K+ followers. Show us the accounts..

• Multiple viral videos (1M+ views) that you concepted or led, not just contributed to. Show us the videos..

• Deep understanding of short-form video strategy, hook writing, and current platform algorithms..

• Strong written communication and creative brief writing..

• Comfortable working in a fast-moving brand where direction shifts and you ship anyway..



Bonus Experience

• Promoting events, conferences, or live experiences and driving ticket sales through organic content..

• Working with personal brands or female-led business brands..

• Direct response and conversion-focused content (not just brand-build)..

• Podcast content strategy..



Ideal Candidate

You are someone who:



• Lives and breathes social media and watches trends like other people watch the news..

• Has strong opinions on what works and why, and can back them up with data and case studies..

• Is a strategist first, not a creator. You direct the work, you don't make it..

• Can take a personal brand and 10x it within a year..

• Wants to be measured on growth and conversion, not output..



How You'll Work With the Team

• Founder:Weekly strategy meeting. You bring the plan, she signs off and brings the voice..

• Marketing assistant:You hand her the brief. She executes. She does not change the strategy..

• Video editor and designers:You direct what they make..

• Ads manager:You align paid and organic so they reinforce each other..



Rate

To be discussed based on experience and proven track record.



How to Apply

Send the following:



1. A 1-page note on why you'd be great for this role..

2. Three accounts you've grown, with before/after metrics and what you did..

3. Three viral videos you concepted (links, view counts, and what made them work)..

4. Your monthly rate and what's included..

- Loom videos welcome and encouraged. Generic applications will be ignored.

title: Internal Bookkeeper and Accounting Support Specialist
description:

**$5–$7/hr (Based on Experience) | 20–30 Hours/Week**

**Remote | Must Align with U.S. Central Time Working Hours**

**Growth Opportunity Available**

Harvest AF is growing.



As we continue expanding our tax, bookkeeping, and advisory services, we are looking for an experienced bookkeeper who can take ownership of our internal financial operations and help ensure our firm remains organized, accurate, and financially disciplined.



This is not a client-facing bookkeeping production role.



Your primary responsibility will be maintaining and improving Harvest AF's internal accounting and bookkeeping systems.



Over time, exceptional performers may have opportunities to assist with client bookkeeping projects, accounting operations, and additional department responsibilities.



---



About Harvest AF



Harvest AF is a U.S.-based financial consulting firm focused on:



• Tax Strategy

• Bookkeeping & Accounting Support

• Financial Clarity for Business Owners



We operate with a faith-driven, service-first mindset while maintaining a culture of urgency, accountability, and excellence.



Our mission is simple:



Help business owners make wise financial decisions through proactive tax planning, financial organization, and stewardship.



---



 Your Mission



Maintain accurate, organized, and decision-ready financial records for Harvest AF.



Your work will directly support:



• Financial reporting

• Management decision-making

• Operational planning

• Tax compliance

• Cash flow visibility

• Long-term business growth



You will help ensure our internal books remain clean, accurate, and reliable.



---



Primary Responsibilities



Internal Bookkeeping



Maintain and update Harvest AF's books within QuickBooks Online.



Responsibilities include:



• Categorizing transactions accurately

• Reconciling bank and credit card accounts

• Reviewing uncategorized transactions

• Maintaining chart of accounts integrity

• Tracking expenses and vendor payments

• Monitoring bookkeeping accuracy



---



Monthly Reconciliations



Perform regular reconciliations including:



• Bank accounts

• Credit cards

• Payment processors

• Internal financial records



All reconciliations should tie out accurately and be fully documented.



---



### Financial Reporting



Prepare and maintain:



• Profit & Loss Statements

• Balance Sheets

• Cash Flow Reports



Provide leadership with timely and accurate financial information.



---



Accounting Support



Assist the Operations and Leadership teams with:



• Financial tracking

• Expense monitoring

• Internal reporting requests

• Process improvements

• Documentation and recordkeeping



---



### Process Improvement



We are looking for someone who can think critically and improve systems.



You should be comfortable:



• Identifying inefficiencies

• Suggesting improvements

• Creating consistency

• Maintaining organized financial records



---



Future Growth Opportunities



This role begins with responsibility for Harvest AF's internal books.



As trust, performance, and capacity grow, opportunities may become available to assist with:



• Client bookkeeping cleanup projects

• Financial statement preparation

• Accounting department support

• Special projects

• Expanded responsibilities and compensation



Additional client-facing responsibilities may qualify for future incentive programs and expanded compensation opportunities.



---



# Non-Negotiable Requirements



You must:



• Have experience with U.S.-based bookkeeping

• Be proficient in QuickBooks Online (QBO)

• Be comfortable working during U.S. Central Time business hours

• Be detail-oriented and highly organized

• Be proactive and self-directed

• Communicate clearly and professionally



If you require constant supervision or extensive training on bookkeeping fundamentals, this role is not the right fit.



---



# Preferred Qualifications



• 2+ years of bookkeeping experience

• Experience with QuickBooks Online

• Understanding of reconciliations

• Understanding of month-end processes

• Experience preparing financial reports

• Strong written English communication



Bonus (Not Required):



• Accounting background

• Experience supporting CPA firms

• Experience working with tax teams

• Familiarity with TaxDome or similar platforms



---



# What Success Looks Like



Within your first 90 days:



• Internal books are consistently accurate

• Bank and credit card accounts reconcile correctly

• Financial reports are delivered on time

• Leadership has confidence in the numbers

• Processes become more organized and efficient



---



# Important Compensation Note



This position focuses primarily on Harvest AF's internal bookkeeping and accounting operations.



Certain incentive programs, including client-production-based bonuses and 13th-month bonus programs associated with client bookkeeping production work, do not apply to this internal accounting position.



Future eligibility for additional incentives may be reviewed if responsibilities expand into client-facing bookkeeping production work.



---



# Why Join Harvest AF



• Long-term opportunity with a growing firm

• Direct exposure to tax, bookkeeping, and advisory operations

• Opportunity to increase responsibilities over time

• Stable workload

• Flexible growth path

• Faith-driven and purpose-centered culture

• Opportunity to help build systems, not just perform tasks



---



# How to Apply



Subject Line:



**Internal Bookkeeper Application – [Your Name]**



Please include:



• Your experience with U.S. bookkeeping

• QuickBooks Online experience

• Financial reporting experience

• Current working hours (your local time)

• Confirmation of your ability to align with U.S. Central Time hours



---



# Required Questions



1. What is the first thing you review when taking over a company's bookkeeping and why?



2. Walk us through your month-end reconciliation process.



3. What financial reports do you believe business owners should review most frequently and why?



---



# Hiring Process



• Application Review

• Interview

• Paid Skills Assessment

• Trial Period

• Hiring Decision



We move quickly and are looking for someone who can begin contributing immediately.



If you're looking for a role where you can help build the financial foundation of a growing firm while creating opportunities for future advancement, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Engineering Manager (Delivery & Execution)
description:
We are seeking an Engineering manager who can own predictable delivery across engineering by enforcing sprint discipline, decision clarity, and execution standards. Reduce coordination cost, eliminate rework, and ensure that engineering output is reviewable, shippable, and on time.



Core Responsibilities



Sprint Ownership & Delivery Control

• Own sprint planning, execution, and closure

• Enforce sprint scope boundaries (no silent mid-sprint additions)

• Ensure all tickets entering a sprint meet Definition of Ready

• Track and act on: ticket aging, spillover, churn, blocked work

• Move tickets aggressively across states (TODO ? IN PROGRESS ? REVIEW ? DONE)

• Kill zombie tickets



Timebox Enforcement

• Treat timeboxes as coordination contracts, not estimates

• Require proactive communication before a timebox slips

• Block review if timebox standards are violated

• Escalate early, not after the fact



Execution Quality Gates

• Enforce: Definition of Ready (before sprint), Definition of Done (before release)

• Reject work that: contains implicit decisions, lacks acceptance criteria, introduces duplication without approval

• Ensure code review happens before QA

• Ensure QA does not compensate for missing engineering clarity



Decision Discipline (in partnership with TPM / Product)

• Require explicit tracking of: Open Decisions, Frozen Decisions

• Block execution on unresolved architectural decisions

• Ensure decisions are made by the right group, at the right time

• Prevent “decision by implementation”



5. Engineering Standards Enforcement

• Enforce agreed standards consistently: no duplication without approval, no implicit architecture decisions, no skipping ticket states

• Treat violations as delivery risk, not personal issues

• Track repeat violations and escalate



Required Skills & Traits



Must Have

• Strong judgment around delivery tradeoffs

• Comfort enforcing rules and saying “no”

• Ability to stop work and force alignment

• Low tolerance for ambiguity in execution

• Bias for early escalation over late heroics

• Calm under pressure, emotionally neutral

• Experience running sprints that actually ship

• Strong English language skills

• Familiarity with Jira-style workflows



Nice to Have

• Background as senior engineer

• Experience in SaaS / platform teams

• Worked alongside TPMs or Product Managers

title: Product Manager (Technical) / Software Architect
description:
We are seeking a Technical Product Manager / Architect who bridges product design and engineering execution. This role combines system-level thinking, architectural oversight, and clear, actionable documentation—producing deliverables engineers can build from directly. The ideal candidate can translate business needs into architecture diagrams, wireframes, and well-scoped tickets with code-level precision, ensuring efficient handoff and reduced rework.



Requirements & Documentation

• Author architecture-aware product specifications including system diagrams, logic flows, and key technical dependencies.

• Conduct architecture and code reviews, identifying potential design or implementation issues early.

• Build wireframes, mockups, and interaction flows using Figma or equivalent tools to align engineering and UX/UI early in the cycle.

• Collaborate with engineering to ensure technical feasibility and architectural scalability before feature commitment.

Cross-Functional Execution

• Work closely with engineering leads to break down architecture into structured deliverables and sprint-ready tasks.

• Lead technical review sessions to validate assumptions and architecture decisions before coding begins.



Qualifications

• Strong understanding of software architecture principles, REST APIs, and modular system design.

• Hands-on experience writing or reviewing code in PHP, JavaScript, and SQL preferred.

• Proficiency in creating wireframes, prototypes, and UI flows that accurately reflect data and system constraints.

• Ability to evaluate trade-offs between architectural purity, delivery speed, and scalability.

• Prior experience functioning as a bridge between engineering and design, ensuring clarity and readiness for execution.

title: Senior Webflow Developer
description:
About uBloom Digital



uBloom Digital is an Australian web design and brand development agency. We work with ambitious builders, architects, and property developers, helping them stand out, attract better clients, and grow through premium websites and sharp digital strategy.



Our work is held to a high standard. Every project we take on is built to make a genuine impact on our client's business, not just look good. We combine strong design, smart positioning, and technically polished execution to deliver websites that actually move the needle for the people we work with. Our team is everything to us and is what makes it all possible!



Job Details



As the Senior Webflow Developer, you will work closely with the CEO to lead the build and delivery of client projects from start to finish. You will take Figma designs, creative briefs, and strategic direction and turn them into premium, high-performing websites in Webflow.



This is not a support role. You will own the development side of every project, manage your own workload across multiple active builds, and be trusted to deliver without constant oversight. Over time, you will take on direct client communication and become a key part of how uBloom operates and grows.



This role suits someone who is highly skilled, self-directed, and genuinely proud of the work they put out. You care about the details, you communicate clearly, and you want to be part of something that is building toward something real.



uBloom is a growing creative and digital studio working with premium architecture, construction, and lifestyle brands. This role offers the opportunity to become deeply embedded in the business, develop strong development and project management skills, and take on increased responsibility over time. Prior experience is essential; a strong work ethic, sound judgement, and willingness to be part of the team are key.



Time requirement



9am - 6pm Brisbane Time (1 hour lunch)

Monday - Friday

13th Month Included

Australia Holiday Schedule



Responsibilities



Client project delivery



- Take completed Figma designs and build them in Webflow to a premium, pixel-accurate standard

- Develop custom interactions and animations using GSAP and native Webflow to a high level of polish

- Write clean JavaScript to extend functionality beyond native Webflow where required

- Work from partial briefs or design direction and apply enough design judgement to execute independently

- Manage multiple active projects simultaneously inside Notion without losing detail or missing deadlines

- Handle DNS configuration, domain setup, and full site launches independently



Existing project management



- Audit and clean up Webflow projects inherited from previous developers

- Restructure class names, organise styles, and implement cleaner development systems into existing builds

- Fix bugs, resolve layout and interaction issues, and improve overall project quality

- Implement website changes, new features, and additional functionality onto live client websites

- Navigate complex Webflow projects calmly and methodically without breaking what already works



Internal systems and frameworks



- Help build and refine uBloom's internal Webflow frameworks and component systems

- Contribute to the development of repeatable build processes that improve speed and consistency across projects

- Assist in building and improving internal task management systems inside Notion

- Document processes clearly so systems can be followed, improved, and handed over where needed



Standards and organisation



- Maintain clean, organised class naming conventions across every project without being asked

- Structure Webflow projects for long-term maintainability from the very first build session

- Communicate progress proactively, flag blockers early, and keep work moving without being chased

- Follow and actively contribute to uBloom's internal SOPs and build processes



Requirements for consideration



- 4+ years Webflow experience with a strong portfolio of premium, design-forward builds

- Advanced GSAP skills used regularly and confidently across real client projects

- Include an animal that best represents you in the subject line (required)

- Solid JavaScript ability for custom interactions, logic, and extended functionality

- Strong Figma-to-Webflow workflow with the design understanding to fill gaps independently

- Demonstrated ability to audit, clean up, and improve Webflow projects built by others

- A disciplined, consistent approach to class naming and project organisation

- Experience managing DNS settings and handling full site launches without support

- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining a high standard of quality

Systems minded. You think about how to do things in a repeatable, scalable way, not just how to get the current task done

- Clear, professional written communication in English

- Reliable internet connection and consistent availability during agreed working hours

- Familiarity with Notion for project and task management

- Finsweet attributes experience is optional but a good advantage

- This must be your only role. Exclusive commitment is required



Why you’ll love working at uBloom Digital



This role goes well beyond executing tasks from a list. This is a fully remote role where you will be trusted with real responsibility from day one. You will be given genuine ownership over your work and the space to do it well. The work you build will be seen by hundreds of thousands of eyeballs across Australia and will directly shape how our high-end clients businesses grow and compete.



Culture matters at uBloom. We are a small, tight team that takes the work seriously but does not take itself too seriously. We care about quality, we move fast, and we back the people we work with. Outside of work the founders and team are into fitness, sport, health, and generally having a fun lifestyle, and we think that balance matters.



As the business grows, there is a real opportunity to grow with it. We value long-term relationships, reliability, and people who want to keep getting better. Initiative is rewarded with more responsibility, better projects, and progression over time. If you want to do some of the best work of your career inside a thoughtful and ambitious agency, this role is for you.



Compensation



$2,500-3,000 USD per month

13th Month Guaranteed



Overall, we are looking for a person with a positive attitude, professionalism, reliability, great time management skills, open communication, and a passion to learn! If this is you or someone you know, please apply with your resume and cover letter

title: Short-Form Video Editor – Personal Brand (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
Job Description:



I’m a 26-year-old entrepreneur based in Koh Samui, Thailand, running a portfolio of businesses. I’m building a personal brand on TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and YouTube long-form. I need a dedicated short-form video editor who can turn daily raw footage into 3 polished short-form videos per day (and eventually 1 long-form per week).



This is a full-time, long-term position. You will be my only editor. I film everything on iPhone and Insta360. Every evening I send you raw footage + a 60-second WhatsApp voice note briefing what each video should be. You deliver the 3 finished videos by the next morning (your time).



Style Reference:



The visual style I want is modeled after Trey Gustafson on 
 his content before applying. Key elements of this style:



Cinematic color grading – moody, dark tones with lifted shadows, desaturated midtones, teal/orange color split

Music-driven editing – cuts sync to the beat, pacing follows the energy of the track



Clean, minimal captions – bold sans-serif text, centered or lower-third, no flashy animations or emoji overlays

Smooth transitions – speed ramps, whip pans, match cuts between locations



Cinematic B-roll integration – tight product shots, environment shots, lifestyle footage layered over voiceover

Premium feel – this is NOT the typical fast-cut, 
-style TikTok editing. It’s elevated, clean, and intentional



Your Daily Workflow:



- I send you raw footage (iPhone 14 + Insta360 Go 3S clips) via Google Drive every evening

- I send a 60-second WhatsApp voice note explaining the 3 videos I want: the hook, the angle, and which clips to use

- You edit, color grade, add music, add captions, and deliver 3 finished short-form videos (30–90 seconds each)

- Turnaround: same day or by next morning (within 12 hours of receiving the brief)

- Deliver via Google Drive in 9:16 format, optimized for TikTok/Reels/Shorts



Required Skills:

- Proficient in CapCut Pro, Premiere Pro, or DaVinci Resolve (CapCut Pro preferred for speed)

- Strong color grading ability – you must be able to replicate the cinematic look described above, not just slap a filter on

- Typography and caption design – clean, readable, brand-consistent text overlays

- Music selection and beat-synced editing – you source the tracks (royalty-free) and cut to the rhythm

- Understanding of short-form content pacing – you know how to keep viewers past the first 3 seconds

- Reliable internet and able to download/upload large video files daily

- Available for WhatsApp communication during briefing hours (evening Thailand time / morning Philippines time)



Nice to Have (Not Required):

- Experience editing for entrepreneur/business content creators

- Familiarity with TikTok and Instagram Reels trends

- Ability to suggest hook improvements or creative angles based on what you’re seeing perform well

- Experience with YouTube long-form editing (will be added to your scope later)



Compensation:

$750–$1,000 USD/month (full-time), depending on skill level and experience. + Performance bonuses when content hits milestones. This rate will increase as the brand grows and your scope expands to include long-form editing.



How to Apply:

Send me:

Your portfolio or 3 examples of short-form videos you’ve edited (links to TikTok, Reels, or YouTube Shorts you edited)

A brief note on which editing software you use and your daily availability



Your honest assessment: look at Trey Gustafson’s TikTok 
 and tell me – can you replicate this style? What would you do differently?



If your application is strong, I’ll send you a paid test clip ($20) to edit before making a final decision.

title: Experienced Dropshipping Product Researcher for Health & Beauty Ecommerce Brand
description:
We are a growing dropshipping ecommerce company focused on health, beauty, wellness, and personal care products like creams, patches, oils, drops, and similar items.



We are looking for an experienced Product Researcher who can help us find strong products to test in our online stores.

This is not an entry-level role. We need someone who already understands dropshipping product research, competitor research, Meta and
 Ad Library, product validation, creative swipes, advertorials, funnels, and basic margin checking.



Your main job is to find products that have real customer demand, clear pain points, active competitors, useful ad references, and good potential for testing. We want someone reliable, detail-oriented, and able to clearly explain why a product is worth testing, not just send random product links.



What You'll Do

1. Research health, beauty, wellness, and personal care products, including creams, patches, oils, drops, and similar items that sell well online.

2. Use Meta Ad Library to find active competitor ads and high-reach creatives.

3. Research competitor product pages, advertorials, funnels, and offers.

4. Find strong hooks, angles, pain points, and customer problems behind each product.

5. Check if there are enough swipes, ads, images, and references for creative production.

6. Tell whether a competitor is testing or scaling a product.

7. Check basic supplier availability, product cost, and margin potential when needed.

8. Organize product findings clearly in Google Sheets with links, screenshots, notes, and reasoning.

9. Explain why each product is worth testing.

10. Follow SOPs and improve the quality of your research over time.



What We Need From You

1. Previous dropshipping or ecommerce product research experience. Be ready to show examples.

2. Solid working knowledge of Meta Ad Library.

3. Strong understanding of competitor research and product validation.

4. Able to find active ads and tell if competitors are testing or scaling a product.

5. Comfortable researching health, beauty, wellness, and personal care products.

6. Organized and able to work in Google Sheets.

7. Good written English.

8. Detail-oriented and able to follow SOPs.

9. Able to explain your product reasoning clearly.

10. Reliable, responsive, and consistent with daily work.



Nice to Have

1. Experience with Shopify.

2. Experience with AliExpress, CJdropshipping, or other supplier platforms.

3. Experience with ClickUp, Slack, and Google Drive.

4. Experience with ad spy tools.

5. Experience researching products for the UK, US, EU, or similar markets.

6. Experience finding winning ad angles, hooks, and creative swipes.

7. Experience reviewing advertorial pages or ecommerce funnels.



Test Task Notice

There will be a short product research test task before hiring. The purpose is to check your real research skill, your ability to use Meta Ad Library, your understanding of competitors, and how clearly you can explain why a product is worth testing. Please do not apply if you are not experienced in dropshipping product research.



How to Apply

Start your application message with the word RESEARCH so we know you read the full job post. Messages that do not start with RESEARCH will be ignored.



In your message, include:

1. Your dropshipping or ecommerce product research experience.

2. Proof of past work, such as screenshots, sample sheets, or products you found.

3. The tools you have used for product research.

4. The niches or markets you have researched before.

5. One example of a product you found in the past and why it was a good product.

6. Your expected monthly salary.

7. Your availability and preferred working hours.



Please Answer These Questions

1. How many years of dropshipping or ecommerce product research experience do you have?

2. What tools do you use to find products and competitors?

3. How do you use Meta Ad Library to validate a product?

4. What makes a product worth testing in dropshipping?

5. What health, beauty, wellness, or personal care products have you researched before?

6. How do you check if a competitor product is actually active or performing?

7. What information would you include in a product research sheet?

8. Are you comfortable completing a product research test task before hiring?

9. What is your expected monthly salary for full-time work?

10. When can you start?

title: QA Tester / QA Analyst — WordPress/WooCommerce Marketplace (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
We're looking for an experienced QA Tester / QA Analyst to join our team full-time, focused primarily on testing a WordPress + WooCommerce multi-vendor marketplace project — a new layer of marketplace functionality built on top of our existing ecommerce store.

 

While the marketplace is the main priority, this is a full-time role: you'll also help with QA across the website as a whole, picking up other testing needs as they come up. Think of yourself as the QA owner for the whole platform, not just one feature set.

 

This is primarily a manual functional and exploratory QA role. Automation experience is a nice-to-have, not a requirement.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 

You'll review marketplace flows at a high level, verify what's working, find issues, and produce clear QA reports with visual confirmation. Main areas include:

 

• Seller lifecycle: application, approval/rejection, seller roles and permissions

• Marketplace browsing: catalogue/archive pages, offer cards, filters, sorting, pagination, empty/expired states

• Public seller profiles/store pages

• Marketplace offer and image-related flows (where applicable)

• Buyer checkout: behavior involving marketplace offers and warranty options

• Wallet system: pending/available/paid balances, hold periods, withdrawal requests, admin disbursement, ledger history, CSV export, refunds/reversals

• Reviews: submission, editing, moderation/admin review, display, aggregation, notification
s

• Warranty: quote popup, checkout persistence, claim form, admin claim resolution

• Fulfillment/SLA foundation: delivery tier behavior, SLA deadline/order metadata, fulfillment status metadata

• Admin marketplace configuration: per-game config, filter tree, site settings, empty-state/illustration settings

• General QA: cross-browser/mobile checks, console errors, broken layouts, permission issues,
 triggers, basic REST/API behavior

• Beyond the marketplace: supporting QA needs across the rest of the website as they come up

 

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

 

• Strong manual QA experience

• Ecommerce or marketplace testing experience

• WordPress/WooCommerce experience preferred

• Comfortable testing role-based flows: buyer, seller, admin

• Basic API testing with Postman or similar

• Comfortable using browser DevTools for console/network checks

• Can write clear bug reports: repro steps, expected result, actual result, screenshots/video, browser/device, severity

• Good English communication, written and verbal

• Can produce clean, organized screen recordings to share with the client

 

Automated regression testing experience is a bonus — not required. The immediate need is a strong manual QA tester who can understand business flows deeply, test them carefully end-to-end, and deliver a reliable QA report with clean visual evidence.

 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR (PERSONALITY/FIT)

 

• Takes ownership — tests this like it's your own product, not just a checklist of assigned tickets

• Gets things done — we need someone effective, not just someone who's online and "available"

• Proactive — flags risks and gaps, doesn't just wait to be told what to test next

 

BENEFITS

 

• Paid vacation leave after 3 months

• Stable, long-term role with a growing company

 

ROLE DETAILS

 

• Location: Remote (Philippines)

• Working Hours: TBD, quite flexible

• Time Tracking: Required

 

DELIVERABLES YOU'LL OWN

 

• QA test plan/checklist

• Executed test report

• Prioritized/severity-tagged bug list

• Retesting confirmation for fixed issues

• Final QA summary: pass/fail, blockers, risks, and recommendation

• Client-ready visual confirmation package: short videos/screenshots for every flow that can be shown visually

 

On visual evidence: record short, clean videos for key working flows — not just raw bug evidence for internal use. These videos may be used in client presentations, so they need to be organized, understandable, and free of unnecessary debug/admin noise. Developer recordings and PR testing notes can be used as a reference, but you'll verify independently and produce the final client-ready evidence yourself.

 

Videos should be grouped by feature/flow, for example:

• Buyer browsing catalogue/filtering/opening an offer

• Buyer checkout with marketplace offer and warranty option

• Seller application and admin approval/rejection

• Public seller profile/store page

• Wallet summary, ledger, withdrawal request/admin handling

• Review submission/display/admin moderation

• Warranty quote/claim/admin resolution

• Admin marketplace configuration/per-game settings

• Offer/image-related flows (where applicable)

 

HOW TO APPLY

 

Include "MC" in your subject line. Briefly answer the following:

 

1. What's the most complex QA project you've worked on or contributed to (ideally ecommerce/marketplace)?

2. How did you track testing coverage, bugs, or results?

3. What tools or systems did you use to manage test plans, bug tracking, or reporting?

4. Give one example of how you improved a QA process or caught something others missed.

 

Attach your resume and a link to your LinkedIn profile.

 

Applications that do not answer all questions will not be considered.

 

IMPORTANT

 

Do not apply if you don't have hands-on manual QA experience, ideally with ecommerce or marketplace platforms. You must:

 

• Have real experience testing complex, role-based web applications

• Understand how QA workflows operate in practice, not just "click around and report bugs"

• Be capable of owning test planning and reporting, not just executing assigned test cases

 

This is not a training role.

title: I have 7 apps bundled into one i need help with
description:
I need a full-stack vanilla-JavaScript + React Native developer 

to ship a suite of small cross-platform apps (web PWA + iOS + 

Android).



The stack is deliberately lightweight:

- Pure HTML/CSS/JavaScript

- No build step

- No TypeScript

- Minimal dependencies

- Shared engine files run identically on web and native

- Offline-first PWAs



If you're someone who can't wait to "modernize" this with 

Next.js, TypeScript, and a big framework, this role isn't for 

you. I built it lean on purpose. I want a developer who's 

RELIEVED by a minimal stack, not annoyed by it.



The work:

- Take small apps from working demo to shipped on App Store, 

  Play Store, and web

- 7 mini-apps in total, all structured identically — learn one, 

  the rest go fast

- Payment integrations: RevenueCat (native) and Stripe (web)

- Service workers, caching, install-to-home-screen

- Each app is intentionally small and bounded



How we'll start — paid trial:



You build (or finish) ONE small self-contained app in the 

existing pattern. A few screens, the shared engine, the paywall 

hook, an offline service worker. Real bounded task, paid at 

your rate. Strong work leads to ongoing engagement across the 

full suite of 7 apps.



I'm running a few of these trials in parallel with different 

developers. Top performers continue.



Pay:

- Trial: $
flat for one small app (depending on scope 

  and your rate)

- Ongoing: $15-25/hour, depending on your experience

- If you're senior and command more, tell me and make your case



WHAT I NEED TO KNOW ABOUT YOU:



1. Send links to 2-3 cross-platform or PWA apps you've 

   personally shipped. App Store links, Play Store links, or 

   live web URLs. Not "projects I helped with" — your work. 

   Without these, your application won't be read.



2. In one paragraph: tell me how you actually feel about a 

   no-build, no-TypeScript, minimal-dependencies codebase. 

   Be honest. If you'd push back on it, tell me when and why. 

   I'm not looking for the "right answer" — I'm looking for 

   YOUR answer.



3. Your experience with RevenueCat for native payments and 

   Stripe for web payments. How many apps have you shipped 

   with each? Have you handled subscription edge cases — 

   restore purchases, family sharing, grace periods, failed 

   renewals?



4. Walk me through one offline-first PWA you built. What was 

   the caching strategy? How did you handle conflicts between 

   offline and online state?



5. Tell me about a time a client wanted a feature you thought 

   was a bad idea (over-engineering, wrong tool, scope creep). 

   What did you do? What was the outcome?



6. Describe your current development setup. What other clients 

   or projects are you on right now? How would you fit this 

   work in?



7. What's your hourly rate AND your preferred trial pricing 

   structure (flat fee for the trial app or hourly with a cap)?



TO APPLY:



- Use a multiple of 7 Apply Points (7, 14, 21, 28, etc.). 

  7 is enough if your portfolio and answers are strong.

- Start your message with the word "offline-first"

- Answer all 7 questions. Skipping any = automatic rejection.

- Without shipped apps linked in your answer to Q1, I won't 

  read the rest.



Important notes:

- IP-sensitive project. Trial work requires a short NDA and 

  IP-assignment before I share any code. Standard, not scary, 

  but tells you I take it seriously.

- I will NOT ask you to do free spec work. Every trial is paid.

- This is ongoing work, not one-off. The right person could be 

  busy with this for years across the suite also doing upgrades and support. 



About me:

I build evidence-first health and human-connection apps 

(web + iOS + Android). The architecture is intentionally simple 

and I want it to stay that way. I value developers who push 

back diplomatically when something's wrong, but who don't 

"modernize" things that don't need modernizing.



I respect expertise, pay on time, and have ongoing work for 

the right person.



To apply: follow the instructions above carefully. Generic 

applications will be skipped.
